decision: Break-glass is used only when automation cannot execute the change.
why: An unrestricted role with no usage boundary becomes the fast path, and the repository stops being the record.

links.note: Stack deny assignments override role actions — break-glass reaches platform resources only if excluded from them.
Policy denies apply regardless of role actions — break-glass cannot deploy an unapproved resource type.

violations: Break-glass used for a change that a pull request could have made.
